sisi.depan: A raised council altar of polished black candi stone is set before a wall featuring inset glowing gold filigree and flanked by two large, frameless holographic data screens.
sisi.kanan: A colonnade of tall, square teak pillars carved with luminous gold batik motifs lines the wall, interspersed with tall, narrow windows made of smart-glass displaying abstract light forms.
sisi.belakang: Two immense, intricately carved teak wood doors form the main entrance, set beneath a suspended observation gallery with a polished stone balustrade.
sisi.kiri: Massive gold fabric banners, each digitally embroidered with the Galians crest of golden wings flanking a circle containing a flame, hang between an identical colonnade of carved teak pillars.

tengah: A long, crimson runner carpet forms a central aisle leading to the altar, flanked by a series of low-profile, floor-mounted uplights that project soft beams onto the ceiling.
atas: A high, multi-tiered joglo-style ceiling is constructed from dark wood beams with recessed strips of warm light, culminating in a central, hexagonal smart-glass skylight showing celestial data.
